messages.text: Our July loss review found that high-value refunds need a second set of eyes. I propose human approval before any refund above $500 is sent to the payment provider.
Approved. Effective immediately, refunds over $500 must be escalated to a human approver before execution. Calculation and identity verification do not change.
Decision status: APPROVED. This supersedes the automatic-execution portion of DEC-REFUND-001.

decision.title: High-value refunds require human approval
decision.text: Refunds over $500 must be escalated to a human approver before execution.
